headline: Phillies rally past Angels in 10th, win third straight
recap: Cristopher Sánchez was excellent, working seven scoreless innings with eight strikeouts and two hits allowed, but reliever Jonathan Bowlan surrendered a game-tying home run to Zach Neto in the eighth. The Phillies broke through with three runs in the top of the tenth to go up 4-1, and Jhoan Duran worked around an unearned run in the bottom half to seal a 4-2 win in Anaheim. Trea Turner (2-for-4, two RBIs) and Kyle Schwarber (RBI double) led the offense, while Trevor Martin took the loss in relief for the Angels.
The win moved Philadelphia to 76-60, second place in the NL East, five games behind the division-leading Braves. The Phillies have won three straight.

Philadelphia closes out the series with the Angels this afternoon, sending Zack Wheeler to the mound against Yusei Kikuchi at Angel Stadium; first pitch is scheduled for 4:07 PM ET. The Phillies then travel to Arizona for a three-game series against the Diamondbacks starting Monday.
